title: An idea you both recognise
meaning: Your shared view can grow through small experiments when each person recognises their own wish in the understanding you find.
text: Sometimes it is easier to understand something together when you can see an idea taking shape. The Empress in the physical position of Ajna suggests making small examples: sketching, assembling or trying something and observing what happens. The Empress in energy gives the same card a different role, a wish to grow an understanding from which your shared life can develop. The Lovers in emotions respond with closeness: there is pleasure in discovering that the thought appeals to both of you. Each person’s living interest helps make the explanation truly shared.

Imagine discussing what your usual evenings seem to lack. Rather than compiling a long list, you try cooking an unfamiliar supper together and notice the conversation coming alive. **A shared view grows where each person recognises their own wish.** The need itself becomes clearer: you wanted a discovery together, and the complicated recipe merely offered an opening. One experience can yield an insight for other evenings while preserving the pleasure of this particular attempt.

The difficulty may arise when a pleasant coincidence becomes an explanation of all your wishes. Wanting to continue a successful discovery, you may hear a small reservation as a rejection of closeness. The shared idea then begins demanding the agreement that once arose freely. It remains fruitful while each person can clarify what they enjoyed and which part they do not yet want to repeat.
